messages:
elaine_support: Maria in BrightLocal reporting a spike of 502/504s hitting /v1/generate from ap-south-1 since ~08:15 UTC. She attached a few curl traces.

maria_customer: hey, seeing ~20% of requests failing with HTTP 504, usually mid-request streaming. Started after we rotated keys this morning.

elaine_support: thx — can you paste one raw curl you used? also SDK language?

maria_customer: JS SDK v1.4.1, sample curl: 

curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \n  -H "Authorization: Bearer <REDACTED>" \n  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \n  -d '{"model":"rwd-2-large","input":"summarize: ...","stream":true}'

raj_eng: picking this up. Quick check: are 504s scattered or in bursts?

maria_customer: bursts — about 1-2min windows every ~10min, p95 latency also up.

sam_oncall: I see elevated 504s and a correlated spike in NAT connection churn to ap-south-1 edge from our edge-proxy metrics. Also an auth-service 5xx around same windows.

ops-bot: Alert: auth-service (auth-v2) 5xx rate > 5% for 2m in ap-south-1; gateway 504s increased 4x.

raj_eng: hypothesis: token rotation + billing writeback race causing authDB locks -> auth svc upstream errors -> gateway gives 504s and clients retry -> connection storm. Need logs.

kevin_billing: we pushed a billing sync deploy this morning at 07:58 UTC that touches customer_kv table and does batched writes. I'll check for long-running tx.

raj_eng: Maria — can you switch your SDK to single-connection mode and lower concurrency while we triage? sample snippet: 

// temporary JS mitigation
const client = new RedwoodClient({ maxConnections: 1, retry: { retries: 2, factor: 1.5 } });
await client.generate(...);

maria_customer: did that — failures dropped to ~2% in next window.

sam_oncall: good signal. I'm seeing many auth-service DB waits: query_time > 2s on customer_kv for rotate_token job. Full trace: 

[auth] 2026-03-16T08:16:02Z ERROR token_rotate id=bl-8732 db_wait_ms=2150 errno=1210
[auth] 2026-03-16T08:16:03Z WARN upstream: connection reset by peer

raj_eng: that aligns. Two actions: (1) roll back billing deploy to reduce write pressure, (2) hot patch auth svc to short-circuit token validation to cache for 30s.

kevin_billing: rolling back billing sync now (cmd: kubectl rollout undo deployment/billing-sync -n prod-ap-south-1). ETA ~2m.

ops-bot: kubectl: rollout undone for deployment/billing-sync in prod-ap-south-1 (revision 4 -> 3).

sam_oncall: after rollback, auth 5xx dropped to baseline within ~90s, gateway 504s trending down. Maria — can you confirm next burst window?

maria_customer: monitoring — next 10min window looks clean, only one timeout. Thanks.

elaine_support: I'll escalate to account team and send customer a short summary + mitigation steps and recommended SDK config until we have a permanent fix.

raj_eng: permanent fix proposals: add short TTL cache on token validation in auth, reduce billing sync batch size, add DB statement timeout and retry with exponential backoff. Also add a circuit breaker in gateway to return 429 early instead of causing client retry storms.

kevin_billing: agree. I'll open a PR to add DB statement timeout + smaller batches; target ship tomorrow EOD.

sam_oncall: mitigation status: rollback applied, auth cache patch shipped to canary, monitoring shows p95 latency back to normal. I'm leaving an incident marker and will follow for next 6 hours.

elaine_support: messaging draft for customer: "We identified high write pressure from a billing sync deploy causing token validation delays and upstream auth errors, which produced gateway timeouts for streaming requests. Immediate mitigation: rolled back billing deploy and applied an auth cache patch. Recommended temporary client config: set SDK maxConnections=1 and reduce retries. We're implementing permanent fixes (DB timeouts, backoff, circuit breaker)." Thoughts?

maria_customer: that looks good — please include that we saw reduced failures after changing client concurrency. Also give ETA for billing fix.

elaine_support: noted, will add ETA: kevin aims to ship DB fix by 2026-03-17 EOD.

raj_eng: follow-ups for eng: add dashboard panel for auth-db wait_ms and circuit-breaker hit count; add synthetic streaming tests during deploys for ap-south-1.

sam_oncall: I'm posting a short incident summary to #incidents and tagging SRE.

ops-bot: Incident: INC-2026-0316-032 created, severity P2, linked thread: 3524689021.

elaine_support: closing loop with Maria in 1h unless we see regressions. Thanks team :thumbsup:
